data.title: Plan D: Storybook-style component isolation in ui-discover

content.text: Placeholder epic for Plan D from the UI/UX quality proposal (report: docs/proposals).
Problem: Full-page snapshot diffs hide component-level spacing regressions inside busy pages. Reviewers cannot see a component standalone — only crowded inside a layout.

- Extend plugins/dso/skills/ui-discover to generate isolated-component fixture pages: for each component in .ui-discovery-cache/components/_index.json, render it solo with representative props on a blank route at /_dso/components/<name>.
- Plan B/C evaluators run against component-isolation routes when a component source file changes — even if no parent route changes.
- Reviewers receive both in-context and isolated screenshots.
Maps to: Paradigm 3 (Storybook MCP / component isolation) in docs/proposals UI design report.
Dependency: meaningful only after Plan A is in place; pairs with Plan B or C. Contingent on the host project having a routable test harness.
Measurable outcome: Catch component-level regressions invisible to full-page snapshots. Track via isolated vs in-context VLM-score delta.
Status: placeholder — requires /dso:brainstorm to expand into a full epic spec.
